caption: Build-time chain: model, import, placement, build. At runtime the SDK publishes a pose every frame, and the anchor holds the content at a fixed point in the real room.

spec.title: AR content pipeline (build time)
spec.aria: Build-time content pipeline for an AR app: a model is made in Blender, imported to Unity, placed using an SDK pose, and built onto a phone. At runtime the SDK updates the pose every frame and an anchor fixes content to a real point.
